title: Is AI generated code secure?
description:
Is AI-generated code secure? By default, the answer might be no.

In this clip, Tessl Founder and CEO, Guy Podjarny, explains why Large Language Models (LLMs) often produce predictable and insecure code, replicating common vulnerabilities like SQL injection. However, these models also hold the key to writing secure code if they're given the right direction and context. 

Guy explores the fundamental problem of prompt injection, where the lines between instructions (control plane) and the data being analyzed (data plane) are blurred. He also shares a powerful example of how AI can be used to automatically identify and fix security issues, turning a potential weakness into a strength.
